chapter: Cab Calloway, Lunceford, Hampton and Armstrong, 1941-45
title: Chick's sister and the money held by Moe Gale
summary: McRae told Chick's sister to ask the Moe Gale office for money Chick had banked there, which angered Gale.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: And Joe Glaser said, "I'll do it."
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
I say, "No, you can't do it, because it belongs to that office over there. That's where the money was made."
The whole thing was that, when Chick's sister came up from Baltimore, we had a meeting. I had to tell her everything.
I say, "Did you get the money from the Moe Gale office, because Chick had an account there."
Because I know Joe Saunders -- he was still living that time -- I says, "We can verify it."
So anyway, she went down and she said, "Well Teddy told me that, you know."
I say, "Tell him what I told you." Because then if you tell him I told you, then he knows that I know what I'm talking about. Then he can't deny it."
And so anyway, she got the money. It was a lot of money left to them.
See, Chick probably left no will or nothing like that, but it was --
See, then he had to give her the money.
